name: Camp-A-While
evidence: satellite (Esri, 900 m frame) at 40.6650,-76.4070: wooded loops on a hillside with trailers under canopy; no stream or pond beside the RV sites (the Google pin sat on a small pond 100 m NE, moved onto the loops) - not waterfront

name: Stony Fork Creek Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 300 m frame) at 41.6385,-77.3725: a row of ~25 RV pads runs along Stony Fork Creek on the campground's west edge, trailers 10-15 m from the bank on open grass with the creek channel visible beside them; the rest of the loops sit around a pond to the east

name: Rustic Acres RV Resort and Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 41.2364,-79.4391: rows of trailers and park models on open ground and in thin woods; no water near the RV rows - not waterfront

name: Don Laine Family Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 40.8664,-75.5186: gravel rows around the office in open fields and along the woods edge; no water - not waterfront

name: Harts Content Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 40.7850,-80.2486: wooded loops of trailers south of the Turnpike; no water - not waterfront

name: Holiday Pines Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 41.0605,-77.2742: wooded loops south of the road; no water - not waterfront

name: Christmas Pines Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 40.6147,-76.0907: loops of trailers in woods west of the pin beside a small pond at the SW corner; the pond is not beside the RV rows - not waterfront (pin moved ~70 m W onto the sites)

name: Powdermill Run Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 41.4783,-80.0179: the campground loop is in a clearing ~150 m NE of the Google pin (moved onto it) between fields; a small pond lies below it to the south, not beside the sites - not waterfront

name: Quiet Oaks Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 41.4531,-77.8229: a large mown field with scattered trailers and a few rows; Cross Fork runs in the woods ~150 m west, not beside the sites - not waterfront

name: Penn's Creek Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 300 m frame) at 40.8578,-77.2515: sites spread under tree cover on the inside of a Penns Creek bend; the bank is wooded and canopy hides whether any pad sits at the water, so it defaults to not waterfront (a per-site map could earn riverfront for the south row)

name: King's Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 40.0887,-77.0447: rows of trailers on open ground east of US 15; no water - not waterfront

name: Ledgedale Recreation Area
evidence: satellite (Esri, 1000 m frame) at 41.3670,-75.3191: the pin is at the marina/launch lot; the campsites are in the woods south of it under full canopy, and the operator itself describes them as within walking distance or a short drive of the lake - not waterfront (pin left at the office/marina; sites under canopy)

name: Riverlands Recreation Area
evidence: satellite (Esri, 300 m frame) at 41.0730,-76.1590: two short gravel rows of trailers in open woods north of the road; no water - not waterfront

name: Whispering Pines Camping Estates
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 41.1794,-76.3190: wooded loops west of the office; a pond lies 250 m NE in a field, not beside the sites - not waterfront

name: Fire Pit Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame, hazy) at 41.0896,-76.5309: loops of trailers in woods south of a field; no water - not waterfront

name: Pine Lane Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 240 m frame) at 42.0040,-80.3930: a row of trailers lines the pond's east bank 5-10 m from the water on open grass, more along its south end; the pond is the campground's centrepiece (pin moved ~40 m E onto that row)

name: Timber Haus Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 41.3125,-79.1717: office building and sites under continuous forest canopy; no stream or pond near the pin - not waterfront

name: Spruce Lake Retreat Family Campground
evidence: operator-published coordinates 41.2266,-75.2676 for the family campground; satellite (Esri, 1200 m frame): campsites in clearings in continuous forest away from the retreat center's ponds - not waterfront

name: Pine Acres Golf & RV Resort
evidence: satellite (Esri, 900 m frame) at 41.8600,-78.7200: a gravel row of RV pads below the clubhouse between the course and the woods; golf-course ponds sit 150 m north, not by the sites - not waterfront (pin moved from the clubhouse onto the row)
